texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上正在发生有趣的社会变革。

由于他们只有我们作为参考，那里的人们开始相信宇宙中的所有生命都像我们一样：互相连接、合而为一。在别无其他参照的情况下，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]急切地希望我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]能进入他们的机构。他们的误解给予我们提升他们文明的良机。然而，如果得知了外面世界的真相（包括非格式塔物种的存在），他们必定会降低对我们的信任。
texts.en:
Intriguing sociological changes are taking place on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

Given they have only ourselves as a reference, the people there have come to believe that all life in the universe must be as we are: connected. One. Without another frame of reference, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than willing to allow our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] access to their institutions. Their misunderstanding could enable us to advance their civilization considerably. However, if the truth about the wider galaxy (and the existence of non-gestalt species) were to become known, they might become less trusting of us.

tooltips.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will advance to their next technological age.

tooltips.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will distrust us and refuse to communicate for a time.
